items.problem: Post-bootstrap build fails with CS0234/CS0103 on Windows.UI.Colors because the namespace mass-rewrite only handles Windows.UI.Xaml.
items.evidence: lessons.json errors_encountered[0-1]; session-log.txt:2806-2813 (errors), :2837/:2847/:2859 (manual fix, +1 build cycle).
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 step 3 rewrites only 'Windows.UI.Xaml'; the non-Xaml helper classes Windows.UI.Colors / Windows.UI.ColorHelper (which also moved to Microsoft.UI) are left un-rewritten.
items.change: Extended the script's mass-replace with two boundary-guarded passes: Windows.UI.ColorHelper -> Microsoft.UI.ColorHelper and Windows.UI.Colors\b -> Microsoft.UI.Colors. The trailing 's'/'Helper' + \b leave the Windows.UI.Color STRUCT untouched.
items.expected_effect: Fully-qualified Windows.UI.Colors/ColorHelper usages compile straight out of the bootstrap; no CS0234/CS0103 on Colors.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run of a sample using SolidColorBrush(Windows.UI.Colors.X), dotnet build emits ZERO 'CS0234 ... Colors does not exist in the namespace Windows.UI' errors without any manual edit; and Windows.UI.Color struct references still compile.

items.problem: The Colors mapping row is passive and lacks the class-moved / struct-stayed distinction, so agents discover the fix only via a build error and risk over-correcting 'using Windows.UI;'.
items.evidence: skill-coverage-gaps.json item 1; MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md mapping table line 157.
items.root_cause: Under-emphasized guidance: the mapping table lists Colors but does not say the Color struct stays, nor which rows the bootstrap auto-applies.
items.change: Added a note under the Namespace Mapping table: Colors/ColorHelper classes move to Microsoft.UI but the Windows.UI.Color struct stays; do not blanket-rewrite 'using Windows.UI;'; the bootstrap auto-handles only Windows.UI.Xaml + Windows.UI.Colors/ColorHelper, other Windows.UI.* rows are manual. Includes the CS0234/CS0103 symptom.
items.expected_effect: When an unqualified or non-auto-handled Windows.UI.* case remains, the agent fixes it correctly (retarget the class, keep the struct) without over-correcting.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, agents do not rewrite Windows.UI.Color (struct) to a non-existent Microsoft.UI.Color, and resolve remaining Colors errors in-line without breaking Color usages.
